LightningComponentBundle.description: Centred headline + subtitle for a chart, with an optional live summary statistic bound to a measure (re-queries on filter change).

property.name: subtitle
property.label: Subtitle
property.description: One line explaining what the chart shows.

property.name: measureField
property.label: Statistic measure
property.description: Optional measure shown as a live chip under the title.

property.name: statLabel
property.label: Statistic label
property.description: Label for the chip, e.g. 'Avg handle time'.

property.name: statSuffix
property.label: Statistic suffix
property.description: Appended to the value, e.g. ' min'.

property.name: accentColor
property.label: Accent colour
property.description: Hex colour for the title and chip.
